text_markup: Some card abilities initiate a {term:trace attempt} (sometimes simply called a {term:trace}) on the Runner. Traces are marked by the language "Trace [N]" on a card, where the given value N is the {term:base trace strength} of the trace. A trace pits the Corp's trace strength against the Runner's link strength, both of which can be increased by spending credits.
